# Fixture

> Fixture is a small site for llmsgen. This file covers version latest.

## Rules

- Sources of truth: https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/api/bridge.yaml and https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/api/openapi.yaml.
- Error classes: `transient`, `rate_limited`, `gone`, `forbidden`, `invalid`.
- Presses: at most 3 seconds.
- Waits: 15 min; edit windows: 60 s; plain: 5 | 6.
- Read [the deep part](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/section/nested/deep.md#deep-part) and https://github.com/muster-io/muster-bridge-go.

## Document map

- [Home](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/index.md): Fixture is a small site for llmsgen.
- [Guide](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/guide.md): Run `make docs. now` to build (RFC 6238) the site, with **bold**.

- [Section index](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/section/index.md): The section collects pages!
